title: Cookbook:20-Ingredient Brownies
ingredients_raw: 1 cup (200 g / 7 oz) white granulated sugar
½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) dutch processed cocoa powder
½ cup (110 g / 4 oz) white granulated sugar
11 oz (330 ml / 1⅓ cups) heavy cream, heated
ingredients: (60 g / 2 oz) dutch processed cocoa powder
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (356°F). Line a 33 x 23 cm (13 x 9-inch) baking pan with parchment.
Melt dark chocolate in microwave using 30-second bursts. Leave it to cool.
Beat the butter and sugars in a large bowl until combined.
Beat in the eggs, salt and vanilla, then beat in the melted chocolate.
Fold in the flour and cocoa, then the chopped chocolate.
Pour the mixture into the lined baking pan.
Meanwhile, make the topping by beating the cheeses in a medium-sized bowl until soft.
Beat in the sugar and vanilla, then beat in the egg and milk.
Take the brownie out of the oven after the 25 minutes of baking.
Pour the mixture over the brownie and bake for a further 30 minutes.
Take the brownie out of the oven and leave it to cool.
Make the ganache by mixing together the chocolate, hot cream and salt in a bowl until melted.
Pour the ganache over the brownie and chill in the fridge for at least a few hours until set.
Sprinkle the brownie with a light sprinkle of salt.
Trim the brownie and cut into 15 squares.

'''20-ingredient brownies''' is a [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] containing 20 ingredients. It is adapted from recipe from the YouTube channel Tasty.<ref>https://google.miraheze.org/wiki/YouTube_Wiki:20-Ingredient_vs._10-Ingredient_vs._2-Ingredient_Brownie_%E2%80%A2_Tasty</ref>
== Ingredients ==

=== Brownie ===
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (275 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 cup (200 g / 7 oz) white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 3 sticks (375 g / 13 oz) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (200 g) [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* 8 oz (227 g) dark [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]]
* 1½ cups (200 g / 7 oz) all-purpose flour
* ½ cup (60 g / 2 oz) dutch processed cocoa powder
* 8 oz (227 g) semisweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

=== Topping ===
* 16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (450 g) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* 1 cup (300 g / 10.5 oz) [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|mascarpone cheese]]
* ½ cup (110 g / 4 oz) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (50 g) [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]

=== Frosting ===
* 11 oz (310 g) chocolate
* 11 oz (330 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 1⅓ cups) heavy [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]], heated
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook: Salt|salt]]
* Flaky salt to garnish

== Procedure ==

=== Brownie ===
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|180°C (356°F)]]. Line a 33 x 23 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] (13 x 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]) baking pan with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]].
#Melt dark chocolate in [[Cookbook:Microwave|microwave]] using 30-second bursts. Leave it to cool.
#[[Cookbook:Beat|Beat]] the butter and sugars in a large bowl until combined.
#Beat in the eggs, salt and vanilla, then beat in the melted chocolate.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in the flour and cocoa, then the chopped chocolate.
#Pour the mixture into the lined baking pan.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 25 minutes.

=== Topping ===
#Meanwhile, make the topping by beating the cheeses in a medium-sized bowl until soft.
#Beat in the sugar and vanilla, then beat in the egg and milk.
#Take the brownie out of the oven after the 25 minutes of baking.
#Pour the mixture over the brownie and bake for a further 30 minutes.
#Take the brownie out of the oven and leave it to cool.

=== Frosting ===
#Make the [[Cookbook:Ganache|ganache]] by mixing together the chocolate, hot cream and salt in a bowl until melted.
#Pour the ganache over the brownie and chill in the fridge for at least a few hours until set.
#Sprinkle the brownie with a light sprinkle of salt.
#Trim the brownie and cut into 15 squares.
